title: Officer, Specialist, Operations, Trns Svcs-Trade Operations, Corporate Banking, Technology and Operations
description:
**Business Function**
 Group Operations enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble, and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality \& control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Operations, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels. As an Operations Department, we embrace and reinforce the strong PRIDE! culture that is built up in DBS. This is done through strategic focus on training and improving staff capability, empowerment, productivity, teamwork, innovation \& technology, managing operational risks \& strongly collaborating with our business partners in delivering excellent RED service to our customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Process and scrutinize Trade transactions as per the applicable FEMA guidelines
* Prepare and submit various MIS reports such as R\-return, CBWTR, EDPMS and IDPMS
* Demonstrate knowledge of processing exports and import transactions
* Assist with other miscellaneous facilities under regulators.
* Scrutinise and inputting the Export/Import cases in core system


**Requirements**
* Awareness of basic FEMA guidelines related to Trade Transactions
* Knowledge of reporting applicable transactions under various Trade transactions
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with accuracy
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Proficient in using relevant banking and financial systems

 I\-Think Techno, Kanjurmarg

 Operations
